title: Property Owners’ Association v. State of Maharashtra

content.caseIdentity: Property Owners’ Association v. State of Maharashtra, 2024 INSC 711
content.holding: A nine-judge Constitution Bench held that material resources of the community under Article 39(b) are not confined to resources owned by the State or its agencies; whether a resource is covered depends on its nature and the constitutional inquiry.
content.relevance: Current authority for Article 39(b) and the surviving Article 31C framework.
